hero-title: Fly Czech: Where your aviation dreams take flight.
services-subtitle: Explore our comprehensive courses and start your aviation journey today.
ppl-description: Learn to pilot single-engine aircraft with comprehensive training in navigation, communication, and hands-on flying.
night-rating-description: Enhance your skills and explore night flying with specialized training after sunset.
radio-description: Master the use of aircraft radios and communication systems to ensure clear and professional exchanges during flights.
icao-description: Achieve the required English proficiency level for international aviation communication with ICAO standards.
experience-subtitle: From thrilling experience flights to professional pilot training—your journey begins here.
pilgrimage-title: Pilgrimage Site Stará Boleslav and Brandýs nad Labem
pilgrimage-description-1:
Become a low-cost sport aircraft pilot.
1-hour experience
Aircraft: Cessna C150/Tecnam P2008JC
Location: Prague
pilgrimage-description-2: Start your adventure in aviation with us! You will prepare the aircraft for the flight with an instructor and then pilot the plane yourself. Meet fellow aviation enthusiasts and share your experiences during the theoretical briefing.
pruhonice-description-1:
Become an exclusive sport aircraft pilot.
1.5-hour experience
Aircraft: Cessna C150/Tecnam P2008JC
Location: Prague
pruhonice-description-2: A special experience for aviation enthusiasts! Includes a 45-minute theory session with pre-flight preparation, a detailed description of the aircraft, and 30 minutes of piloting under instructor supervision—just like a student pilot's first flight.
castles-description-1:
Become a V.I.P. sport aircraft pilot.
2-hour experience
Aircraft: Cessna C150/Tecnam P2008JC
Location: Prague
castles-description-2: An extensive two-hour experience for aviation enthusiasts! Includes a 45-minute theory session with pre-flight preparation, a detailed description of the aircraft, and 60 minutes of piloting under instructor supervision. Enjoy an immersive journey as if you were a student pilot!
fleet-description: Discover our fleet of top-class aircraft, each designed to offer an exceptional flying experience.
fleet-description_default: Discover our fleet of top-class aircraft, each designed to offer an exceptional flying experience.
fleet-discount-note: * Prices don't include 21% VAT. 5% discount when purchasing 10+ hours.
discount-note: * When purchasing 10 hours, you will receive a 5% discount.</br>* Prices don't include 21% VAT
cessna_description: Cessna 150 is a reliable and easy-to-fly trainer ideal for beginner pilots.
cessna 172_description: The Cessna 172 is a reliable and easy-to-fly trainer aircraft ideal for beginner pilots.
bristel_description: Bristel B23 is a versatile aircraft, suitable for both training and leisure flying.
tecnam_description: Tecnam P2008JC is a modern, lightweight aircraft perfect for flight training and touring.
josef_description: Originally an aircraft mechanic and pilot, in addition to working for Czech Airlines and Travel Service / Smartwings, he also worked in so-called third world countries. He participated in the implementation of ICAO standards in the African Congo. He then got a taste of flying in military conflicts and returned to the Czech Republic after working in Dubai to pass on his experience.
josef-bio: Originally an aircraft mechanic and pilot, in addition to working for Czech Airlines and Travel Service / Smartwings, he also worked in so-called third world countries. He participated in the implementation of ICAO standards in the African Congo. He then got a taste of flying in military conflicts and returned to the Czech Republic after working in Dubai to pass on his experience.
robert_description: He has been flying since 2011, more often than seen he is heard - as an AFIS dispatcher or as an air traffic controller. Throughout his life, he gradually gained experience as an aviation freelancer, ranging from aircraft avionics maintenance and pilot training to the development and maintenance of flight simulators around the world. Together with Josef, Robert is responsible for the complete management of the company, you can meet him at most Fly Czech activities.

team-description: Our team, united by a passion for aviation, founded FlyCzech in 2018 to pass on our enthusiasm and contribute to the education of future aviation professionals. We aim to uphold the proud tradition of Czech aviation, improve safety, and provide high-quality training through close cooperation with airlines and aviation organizations.

contact-description: Ready to take a flight? Whether you're interested in beginning your journey as a pilot, booking an introductory flight, or simply learning more about our courses, we're here to help! Contact us today, and let's get you in the air. We are always available on Whatsapp, let's start your aviation journey together!
